form:FormGroup.label: Base URL (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or a self-hosted service. Leave blank to use OpenAI (https://api.openai.com/v1).

g:TextBox.title: Override the URL of the OpenAI-compatible API. Example: https://model-server.example.com/v1

form:FormGroup.label: API Key (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The stored access token credential to send as the API key. Leave blank if the service does not need one.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Access token credential. Leave blank if not needed.

form:FormGroup.label: Model ID
form:FormGroup.helpText: The model name as known by the service, e.g. gpt-4o for a chat model, or the name of an embedding or rerank model.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Name the service uses for the model, e.g. gpt-4o.

g:TextBox.title: ID of the model. Examples: gpt-4o, intfloat/e5-mistral-7b-instruct

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum context window tokens
form:FormGroup.helpText: The largest number of tokens the model can accept at once. Ask Stroom AI uses it to decide when to split large attachments into batches. Elasticsearch reranking also uses it as a limit on the number of characters of each value sent. Set to 0 if not known. Default is 0.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number of tokens. 0 means not set. Default is 0.

v:ValueSpinner.title: Maximum number of tokens allowed in the model's context window. Set to zero to disable.

form:FormGroup.label: Reasoning Effort (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How much reasoning the model does, for models that support it (e.g. OpenAI o-series): low, medium or high. Leave blank to use the model's default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Low, medium or high. Leave blank for the model's default.

g:TextBox.title: Reasoning effort level: low, medium, or high. Leave blank if the model does not support reasoning.

form:FormGroup.label: Embedding model dimensions
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of dimensions for embedding vectors. Lucene supports up to 1024; Elasticsearch up to 4096. Set to 0 to use the model's default. Default is 1024.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Lucene max 1024, Elasticsearch max 4096. 0 uses the model's default.

v:ValueSpinner.title: Number of dimensions to use for embedding models.
